branding.method: Faithful SVG crop/recomposition wrappers preserve supplied JPEG artwork. Navbar, footer and favicon wrappers embed compact 2× PNG renderings of the SVG composition for efficient delivery; primary embeds the original JPEG. PNGs are rendered from the code-native SVG wrappers using Sharp. No logo letters or emblem paths redrawn or synthesized. Footer uses a white plaque. SVG files contain raster artwork and are not original vector logo masters.
